findings.citation: DESIGN.md Badge: "Six tones map 1:1 to semantic colors ..., driven centrally by `lib/status.ts`'s status→tone maps ... so status color is never chosen ad hoc per screen."
findings.note: REVIEW_STATUS (To review / Approved / Sent back labels and tones) is defined inside the component instead of lib/status.ts. Move it there (e.g. reviewStatusToneByValue, reviewStatusLabelByValue) and import it.
findings.reason: Review status maps in lib/status.ts; badges unchanged in goldens.

findings.citation: DESIGN.md Typography: "Body (400–500, 14px, 1.5 line-height): table cells, form values, page copy."; Tabular Everywhere Rule: "so columns of numbers always align"
findings.note: The Agent Invoice row's <Money> has no size class and renders at 16px; in manager-invoices-agent-desktop goldens $3,200.00 is larger than the 14px Client totals and doesn't align with the Total column. Add text-sm (and align it with the column).
findings.reason: Agent Invoice amount 14px tnum; a separate card, not a member of the Total column, so not aligning is not a breach.
